knownIssues.symptom: The game runs its DirectX 8 path (no HDR lighting, simpler water and shaders) on a fresh install
Frame drops when shooting or when an NPC is hit, blood and muzzle flash effects (reported on an M1, macOS 27)
Low frame rate for such an old game, 14 to 33 fps at 1280x720 on an M1 Pro depending on the mode
On the Wine 11 engine r11 with the DXVK mode, no window appears (measured on the demo build on a Wine 11 test engine built from r11's components, 2026-09-24).
Minor stuttering (reported on an M3 Max, macOS 26.5.2, DXMT environment, engine r28)

notes: The upstream recipe has optional settings; see its source for details.
